verdict.rationale: Jira's marketing says Rovo AI can create custom automations, break big ideas into tasks and auto-assign them, and surface trends, which implies some AI-driven operation of the product. An official Atlassian MCP server also lets external AI agents act on Jira. However, no source explicitly says users can issue free-form natural-language commands to perform general operations, and the claims come only from short marketing lines. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language command execution across core actions (create/edit/transition/query issues), detail on how NL-to-JQL or NL-to-action works, independent or hands-on corroboration that Rovo commands work as claimed.
